plain: A person who takes part in an argument.

webster.text: One who disputes; one who argues in opposition to another; a controvertist; a reasoner in opposition.

example.quote: I have addressed myself purely to your judgments, and have studiously avoided those asperities which are too apt to disgrace political disputants of all parties, and which have been not a little provoked by the language and conduct of the opponents of the Constitution.
